en.title: Humayun’s Garden: From Dawn to Delhi Starlight
en.eyebrow:
MUGHAL SYMMETRY IN MINIATURE
RED SANDSTONE & MARBLE
en.headline: Humayun’s
en.dek: A day-to-starlight miniature story of Delhi’s UNESCO sanctuary.
en.notes:
Red sandstone arches.
White marble domes.
A thousand jali lanterns.
en.edition: FROM DAWN CHARBAGH TO DELHI STARLIGHT
en.sceneCaption: HUMAYUN’S SANCTUARY / AN ARCHITECTURAL DAY-TO-STARLIGHT MINIATURE
en.footerLeft: AN ARTISTIC 3D MINIATURE OF DELHI, NOT A FORMAL SURVEY.
en.garden.title: The Garden Island
en.garden.text: Dawn warms the four quarters of Humayun's charbagh as water rills shimmer and rickshaws awaken around the sandstone pavilions.
en.facade.title: The Red Sandstone Facade
en.facade.text: Golden afternoon light washes over the double-storeyed pishtaq archway, revealing carved jali screens and marble inlays.
en.crown.title: The Marble Crown
en.crown.text: At blue hour, twin bulbous marble domes, octagonal chattris and bronze lotus finials rise gracefully into the twilight sky.
en.stars.title: The Starlit Sanctuary
en.stars.text: Warm lanterns glow through geometric jali screens as night falls, and the camera circles back to the opening garden panorama.
en.starsNote: A SANCTUARY GLOWING IN THE NIGHT

en.cardText: Four tiny Delhi moments trace Humayun’s UNESCO sanctuary from dawn rills to a lantern-lit marble crown, returning to the island where the story began.

zh-CN.title: 胡马雍花园：从破晓到德里星夜
zh-CN.wordmarkTag: 胡马雍陵四分花园遐想
zh-CN.eyebrow:
莫卧儿对称美学微缩
红砂岩与大理石
zh-CN.headline: 胡马雍之
zh-CN.dek: 关于德里世界文化遗产圣所的白昼至星夜微缩故事。
zh-CN.notes:
红砂岩拱券。
白色大理石穹顶。
千万盏镂空雕花灯笼。
zh-CN.edition: 从破晓四分花园到德里星夜
zh-CN.sceneCaption: 胡马雍陵圣所 / 一座白昼至星夜的建筑微缩模型
zh-CN.footerLeft: 艺术化微缩城，示意而非测绘重建。
zh-CN.footerRight: 胡马雍陵 — 60 秒德里故事
zh-CN.garden.title: 花园之岛
zh-CN.garden.text: 晨光洒满胡马雍陵四分水渠花园，红砂岩亭台与黄绿三轮车在微缩街景中苏醒。
zh-CN.facade.title: 红砂岩立面
zh-CN.facade.text: 金色午后掠过高耸的双层拱门，斜阳凸显精美镂空雕花窗棂与白色大理石镶嵌纹样。
zh-CN.crown.title: 大理石之冠
zh-CN.crown.text: 蓝调时刻，双重洋葱形大理石穹顶、八角亭阁与青铜莲花顶饰映衬于暮色天空。
zh-CN.stars.title: 星空圣所
zh-CN.stars.text: 星夜降临，温润灯火透过几何雕花窗棂照亮整座圣所，镜头优雅后旋回到初始全景。
